LESSON: ADDITION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers 1.1 Number Concept By the end of the sub-strand,  Learners in pairs/gro
Topic 1.2: Addition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Addition. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-129.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 129]]

From your pupil's book (page 129)

ADDITION Week 3 Lesson 5 Adding a 3-digit number to a 2-digit number Example 1 346 Steps + 53 1. Add ones 6 + 3 = 9 ones 2. Add tens 4 + 5 = 9 3. Bring down the 3 hundreds

Example 2 532 Steps + 46 1. Add ones 2 + 6 = 8 2. Add tens 3 + 4 = 7 3. Bring down 5 hundreds in the hundreds place 532 + 46 57 8

Work to do Add 1. 246 2. 318 3. 425 + 32 + 8 1 + 64

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-215.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 215]]

From your pupil's book (page 215)

Addition Week 2 Lesson 5 Adding a 3 - digit number to a 1 - digit number

Examples 2. 690 +8 = 1. 472 + 6 690 478 + 8 698

Work to do Add 1. 436 2. 247 3. 452 4. 650 + 3 + 2 +7 +`9

9. Ali had 800 goats. He bought 8 more goats. How many goats does he have now? 10. Mary had 102 packets of unga. She bought 7 more packets. How many packets does she have altogether?

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-119.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 119]]

From your pupil's book (page 119)

Activity Let us read 798, 191, 289, 80, 75,

921, 19, 816, 14, 710. Work to do 1. Learners in pairs or in groups to read number symbols 1 - 1000, both forward and backwards

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Addition means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Addition.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Addition
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
